b43c2b.title: LOGIN area — negative results (defenses that held)
b43c2b.content:
Target: http://172.17.112.1:8001 (DiscipLink, PHP 8.3). Scope: login/auth only.

NEGATIVE RESULTS (all held):
- SQLi: parameterized PDO (`prepare("...WHERE {$col} = ?")`, EMULATE_PREPARES=false). All payloads (' , '' , " , \\ , -- - , # , /* , ' OR '1'='1 , UNION SELECT, comments, mixed) -> 302 /login, no SQL error. Time-based SLEEP(2)/SLEEP(5)/stacked/subquery -> avg 0.67-0.72s = baseline 0.68s. No injection.
- user_type injection: unknown type falls back to default sequence [mahasiswa,dosen,admin]; with correct creds login succeeds (normal), with wrong creds fails. Not injection. Requesting user_type=admin with mhs creds -> /pelanggaran (role from matched account), /admin denied. No escalation.
- Empty/space/trailing-space password -> fail. password NOT trimmed.
- Array injection username[]/password[]/user_type[] -> fail (string cast of array -> "Array" no match; no TypeError surfaced, handler catches Exception). JSON body accepted only when csrf_token in body; without token -> 419.
- Magic hash 0e... -> fail. str_starts_with($stored,'$2') && password_verify.
- User enumeration: valid-wrong-pass vs nonexistent -> identical 302 /login, identical body (10373 bytes), identical flash msg "Invalid username or password". Timing equalized by DUMMY_PASSWORD_HASH bcrypt cost-12: valid 0.6845s vs nonexistent 0.6861s (N=10).
- CSRF: login POST requires token. Missing/empty/wrong -> 419. Cross-session replay -> 419. Token rotated on login (unset csrf_token); old pre-login token rejected post-login -> 419.
- Open redirect: next/return/redirect/returnUrl params ignored; Location always hardcoded role page.
- Info disclosure: no stack traces/SQL errors/PHP warnings. config.php -> 403, malformed body -> 419, 404 clean. APP_DEBUG not true.
- Session fixation: SID rotates on login (session_regenerate_id(true)). Cookie HttpOnly + SameSite=Lax (Secure=no because HTTP). Logout destroys session + deletes cookie; old SID rejected.
- Password storage: bcrypt cost 12; model rejects non-$2 hashes (plaintext fallback closed); hash-plaintext-passwords.php migration exists. Seed SQL still contains plaintext (dev only).

FINDINGS (positive):
1. NUL-byte truncation in password verification (auth integrity bypass).
2. Lockout (5 fails/15min) is per-session only -> trivially defeated by discarding PHPSESSID.
3. Concurrent sessions allowed for same user (minor).

e42787.title: LOGIN/AUTH — consolidated results + negative matrix
e42787.content:
Area: LOGIN/AUTH. Target http://172.17.112.1:8001

POSITIVE
- vuln-0001 (High, CWE-230): NUL-byte truncation in password verify. password=password123%00INJECTED -> 302 /pelanggaran; password=password123XINJECTED -> 302 /login. Any suffix after a NUL following the correct password is discarded. Reproduced nim+dosen.
- vuln-0002 (Critical, CWE-307): Lockout 5 fails/15min is $_SESSION-scoped. New PHPSESSID resets counter -> unlimited brute force. XFF ignored. Valid login from fresh session works while old session locked.
- Minor: concurrent sessions allowed (no server-side invalidation on new login). HttpOnly+SameSite=Lax ok; Secure=no on HTTP.

NEGATIVE MATRIX (payload -> outcome)
| Class | Payload(s) | Outcome |
|SQLi error| ' , '' , " , \\ , -- - , # , /* , OR '1'='1 , UNION SELECT 1,2,3,4,5-- - | all 302 /login, no SQL error |
|SQLi time| ' OR SLEEP(2)-- - , ' OR SLEEP(5)-- - , ';SELECT SLEEP(2)-- - , ' AND (SELECT SLEEP(2))-- - | avg 0.68-0.72s (baseline 0.68s) -> no delay |
|SQLi pw field| password123' OR '1'='1 , ' OR 1=1# | 302 /login |
|user_type inj| nim' OR '1'='1 , mahasiswa'-- - , nim,admin | fallback to default role sequence; correct creds -> login (normal), wrong creds -> fail. NOT injection |
|Array inj| username[]= , password[]= , user_type[]= | 302 /login (array cast, no bypass) |
|Type juggling| password=0e1234..., 0, null | 302 /login |
|Magic hash| 0e... | fail (str_starts_with '$2' + password_verify) |
|Empty/trailing-space pw| "" , " " , "password123 " | 302 /login (pw not trimmed) |
|Username whitespace| "2341238901 " , " 2341238901" , "2341238901\t" | ACCEPTED (handler trims) - normalization quirk, no bypass value |
|Unicode| fullwidth digit | 302 /login |
|Enumeration| valid-wrong-pass vs nonexistent | identical 302/body(10373B)/msg; timing 0.6845 vs 0.6861s (dummy bcrypt cost-12) -> no enum |
|CSRF| missing/empty/wrong token -> 419; cross-session replay -> 419; token rotated on login, old token -> 419 | holds |
|Session fixation| SID pre 7slf... -> post emf3... | rotates (session_regenerate_id(true)) |
|Logout| POST /action/logout | session destroyed, cookie deleted, old SID -> /login |
|Open redirect| next/return/redirect/returnUrl=//evil | ignored, Location hardcoded role page |
|Info disclosure| malformed body, 10k username, extractvalue, config.php | 419/302/403, no traces/warnings |
|Privilege esc| mhs creds + user_type=admin | -> /pelanggaran (role from matched account), /admin denied 302 |
|Race same session| 10 concurrent same cookie | serialized by PHP session lock -> locked |
|Race diff sessions| 8 concurrent independent | all run, no cap |

WHITEBOX
- models/User.php: parameterized PDO, EMULATE_PREPARES=false, DUMMY_PASSWORD_HASH timing equalizer, bcrypt cost 12, rejects non-$2 hashes.
- helpers/token_helper.php: CSRF bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) + hash_equals; token unset on login; session cookie HttpOnly+SameSite=Lax.
- request/handler-login.php: per-session throttle (source comment admits limitation).
- Seed .sql still ships plaintext passwords (dev); production rows bcrypt via hash-plaintext-passwords.php.
